# 碳化硅涂层 / SiC TRISO Coating Layer

碳化硅(SiC)是三结构同向性(TRISO)燃料颗粒的主要压力容器层。 SiC coating thermal conductivity at 300 K is 120 W/(m K) for high-purity CVD material. SiC的密度为3.21 g/cm^3，杨氏模量为410 GPa。Youngs modulus was measured by nanoindentation。

# 辐照性能 / Irradiation Performance

快中子注量达到3e25 n/m^2时，SiC的热导率下降至约30 W/(m K)。 At fast neutron fluence of 3e25 n/m^2, SiC swelling is less than 0.5 percent volume change. SiC的熔点为3103 K，剪切模量为170 GPa。
